plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to zero.

conservative.read: This conservative plan aims for lower, steadier returns around 1.5% per month. It significantly reduces risk by cutting leverage and concentration, accepting lower growth potential for capital preservation.

balanced.read: This balanced plan targets approximately 2.5% per month by reducing risk while still seeking growth. It adheres to mandates, trims concentration, and adds a quality name, aiming for controlled risk-first growth.

plan: Add to leveraged ETFs SOXL and SPAL to increase exposure.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month but carries significantly higher risk, including amplified drawdowns and leverage decay from ETFs. It leans into concentration and leverage, requiring strict stop discipline to manage potential rapid losses.

income.read: This income-focused plan targets around 1% per month, prioritizing stable distributions over growth. It minimizes risk by cutting leverage and volatile single names, focusing on income-generating assets and a cash buffer.
